eventDetail.scope: As the 10th edition of the PIC conference series, PIC 2026 centers on promoting frontier research at the crossroads of informatics, artificial intelligence, and next-generation computing, addressing key areas including machine learning, knowledge engineering, computer vision, natural language processing, multimodal data science, large language models, multimodal large language models, LLM-based agent systems, human-computer interaction, software engineering, edge computing, information security, embodied intelligence, robotics, and AI-driven automation. The conference seeks to showcase cutting-edge achievements in intelligent systems, data science, and diverse informatics disciplines, while fostering discussions on innovative theories, practical applications, and emerging technologies that drive progress in real-world AI and computing scenarios.
